description: MiG-21U trainer wearing the false serial CS-117 and No.30 Sqn Rhinos badge, preserved in Chitralekha Udyan (Cole Park), Tezpur; true identity unknown. Still shown in local videos c.2024-25 as the first supersonic fighter of the IAF in Tezpur. Source warbirds.in (Simon Watson photos), YouTube.
aliases: CS117; MiG21U; Tezpur park MiG; MiG21; CS-117
